_meta.indication: XENOVIEW, prepared from the Xenon Xe 129 Gas Blend, is a hyperpolarized contrast agent indicated for use with MRI for evaluation of lung ventilation in adults and pediatric patients aged 12 years and older.
_meta.receipt_date: March 30, 2022 (resubmission received date for this approval cycle)

pivotal_trials.design: Prospective, multi-center, randomized, open-label, cross-over trial comparing XENOVIEW MRI to xenon Xe 133 scintigraphy.
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients being evaluated for possible lung resection surgery with respiratory disorders (pulmonary mass 44%, COPD 35%).
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Within-patient difference in the predicted post-operative percentage of remaining lung ventilation between XENOVIEW and xenon Xe 133 imaging.
pivotal_trials.n: 32 patients completed both scans (31 in the primary analysis).
pivotal_trials.result: Mean within-patient difference met the pre-specified equivalence interval with an observed estimate of 1.4% (95% CI: -0.8%, 3.6%).

pivotal_trials.design: Prospective, multi-center, randomized, open-label, cross-over trial comparing XENOVIEW MRI to xenon Xe 133 scintigraphy.
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients being evaluated for possible lung transplant surgery with respiratory disorders (interstitial lung disease 49%, idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis 29%).
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Within-patient difference in the percentage of overall lung ventilation contributed by the right lung between XENOVIEW and xenon Xe 133 imaging.
pivotal_trials.result: Mean within-patient difference met the pre-specified equivalence interval with an observed estimate of 1.6% (95% CI: -3.7%, 0.5%).

key_safety: Adverse reactions were reported in 12 (14%) of 83 adult patients; those reported by more than one patient were oropharyngeal pain (n=4), headache (n=2), and dizziness (n=2). Inhalation of an anoxic gas may cause transient hypoxemia.
target_moa: When inhaled, hyperpolarized xenon Xe 129 gas distributes throughout the ventilated lung and is directly detected by a Xe 129 MRI coil on a multi-nuclear capable MRI scanner to image ventilation.

advisory_committee.vote: No Advisory Committee meeting or other external consultation was needed for this NDA.

description.text: Expanded pediatric age group from 12 years and older to 6 years and older for lung ventilation MRI

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for the expansion of the pediatric age group for the indication of Xenoview from ages 12 years and older to ages 6 years and older, responding to the pediatric postmarketing requirement 4324-1 to develop an age-appropriate presentation of hyperpolarized Xe 129 that would allow administration of an accurate dose to pediatric patients 6 years to less than 12 years of age.

summary.text: Standard-review 505(b)(2) NDA reviewed by DIRM/OSM; no advisory committee was convened. A Complete Response was issued in the first cycle for product-quality and facility/inspection deficiencies, the NDA was resubmitted March 30, 2022, and it had a Review Completion Date of December 22, 2022 with a pediatric PREA postmarketing requirement.
